status: preregistered exploratory acceptance criteria, not observed results
unit_of_independence: episode or recording session, never adjacent frames

splits.development: choose hypotheses, compute variability and sample sizes

time_contract: Every model feature must be available when the forecast is committed; no future label, visibility or position inputs

capabilities.minimum_useful_effect: At least 1 px median improvement at lead 5 on independently generated 32px scenes; exploratory threshold
capabilities.evidence: Controlled motion extrapolation is a computation; no specific neural mechanism is claimed
capabilities.falsifier: No improvement against coasting across independent trajectories

capabilities.minimum_useful_effect: At least 1 frame median reentry-timing improvement over coasting on guaranteed held-out events
capabilities.species: behavioral developmental analogy, not proof of biological identity
capabilities.evidence: History dependence test: matched last observation, differing earlier motion
capabilities.falsifier: Correct predictions unaffected by history reset or shuffle

capabilities.minimum_useful_effect: Positive held-out action sensitivity with at least 5% error decrease over zero-action input
capabilities.evidence: View prediction requires an explicit known-action contract
capabilities.falsifier: Predictions do not change when planned viewpoint changes

capabilities.minimum_useful_effect: Coverage within ±0.05 of nominal .90 with sharper sets than unconditional baseline
capabilities.falsifier: Mode collapse or high best-of-many accuracy without calibration

capabilities.minimum_useful_effect: At least 10% measured operations saved with no more than 2% foreground-error regression
capabilities.species: hypothesis inspired by selective attention, species mechanisms vary
capabilities.evidence: Allocation logs must verify that work was actually skipped
capabilities.falsifier: Controller changes visualization but not execution or forecast outcomes
